title: How Metals React
summary: Metals with oxygen, water and acids, why sodium lives under kerosene, and why metal oxides are basic but non-metal oxides are acidic.

cbse.chapter: Curiosity Ch 4: The World of Metals and Non-metals (reactions with oxygen, water, acids)

objectives: I can write general word equations for metals reacting with oxygen, water and acids.
I can compare how vigorously different metals react and rank them.
I can explain why metal oxides are basic and non-metal oxides are acidic.
I can explain why some metals are stored under kerosene.
misconceptions: Metal oxides and non-metal oxides behave the same way.
Gold doesn't react because it is 'strong' (it is unreactive, not strong).
